# Literata

The book reader's default typeface (Reading settings → Font → Literata). Upstream: https://github.com/googlefonts/literata,
copied from Google Fonts (`ofl/literata` in https://github.com/google/fonts, 2026-11-05). SIL Open Font License 1.1, see
`OFL.txt`.

- `Literata.woff2` and `Literata-Italic.woff2`: the variable fonts `Literata[opsz,wght].ttf` and
  `Literata-Italic[opsz,wght].ttf` (axes opsz 7–72, wght 200–900), converted to WOFF2 with fontTools, not subset (Latin,
  Vietnamese, Greek, Cyrillic stay in).
